Suspected TB. Is a surgical mask enough?

No. TB is airborne: a fit-tested P2/N95 respirator and a negative pressure room. Measles and varicella are airborne too. Droplet spread, such as influenza or pertussis, needs a surgical mask. Contact spread, such as MRSA or C. difficile, needs gown and gloves.

Would you have picked A) surgical mask or B) respirator? Reply A or B.

Find your weak areas with the free readiness test: https://www.nclexready.com.au/diagnostic?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=reel&utm_campaign=post-15
